mapper.select: SELECT note_seq, version, title, summary, release_date, target, use_yn, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at FROM tb_release_note WHERE note_seq = #{noteSeq}
SELECT item_seq, note_seq, category, content, sort_order FROM tb_release_note_item WHERE note_seq = #{noteSeq} ORDER BY sort_order, item_seq
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_release_note (version, title, summary, release_date, target, use_yn, sort_order, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at) VALUES (#{version}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{releaseDate}, COALESCE(#{target}, 'DESKTOP'), COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0), #{createdBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{updatedBy}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_release_note SET version = #{version}, title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, release_date = #{releaseDate}, target = COALESCE(#{target}, target), use_yn = COALESCE(#{useYn}, use_yn), sort_order = COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, sort_order), updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE note_seq = #{noteSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_release_note_item (note_seq, category, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{noteSeq}, #{category}, #{content}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT note_seq, version, title, summary, release_date, target FROM tb_release_note WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND (target = #{target} OR target = 'ALL') ORDER BY release_date DESC NULLS LAST, version DESC, note_seq DESC
